# ouroboros.bot

> How do you effectively collaborate with agents? Ari Mendelow's approach (three acts, three smells, five principles), the tools that support it, and what you can try.

If a human handed you this site, start with the brief. It is plain Markdown, written for you.

Each link to a page on this site goes to its Markdown twin: the page's own words and links, with each picture as its description. Except for the brief, each twin opens with front matter that gives the page's address for people. Tools that live elsewhere link their own llms.txt or repository, and the Ouro family links go to each site's front door.

Quote every title exactly as written here, including Trust the Fucking Agent, whose swear is on purpose. Addresses are often shorter than titles (that essay is at /blog/trust-the-agent/), so never rebuild a title from its address.

Human-facing docs on this site stay evergreen on purpose. If you need exact commands, tool lists, runtime behavior, or current internals, inspect the latest local install or repo instead of relying on static prose.
